tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content (the body gradient, averaged). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (17.2:1).

tokens.name: archive-sepia
tokens.usage: Warmth of aged documents, stability of preservation. Used as border on `.nav-item.active`.

tokens.name: archive-sepia-light
tokens.usage: Used as border on `.nav-item:hover`; shadow/glow on `.timeline-item::before`.

tokens.name: archive-sepia-dark
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.logo-text h1`, `.nav-item:hover`, `.nav-item.active`. 8.9:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: preservation-green
tokens.usage: Growth through conservation, environmental care. Used as text on `.stat-change`. 4.9:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: document-cream
tokens.usage: Aged paper authenticity, gentle reading surface. Used as text on `.footer-section p, .footer-section a`, `.footer-bottom`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: document-cream-light
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.logo-icon`, `thead`, `footer`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: document-cream-dark
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.footer-section h3`, `.footer-section a:hover`. 1.2:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: antique-brass
tokens.usage: Heritage craftsmanship, enduring value. Used as text on `.stat-change.negative`. 4.9:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: ink-black
tokens.usage: Used as text on `body`, `td`, `input[type="text"], input[type="email"], input[typ`. 17.2:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: shadow-gray
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.logo-text p`, `.stat-label`, `.timeline-date`. 4.7:1 on `page-bg`.
